newsitem.title: LATVIA: OGRE TRIKOTAZA SOLD TO BALTIJAS HOLDINGS.
newsitem.headline: OGRE TRIKOTAZA SOLD TO BALTIJAS HOLDINGS.

text.p: The majority stake in the Ogre knitted garments factory was sold at auction to Baltijas holdings, represented by ex-ministers Eriks Kazha and Vasilii Melnik, the Diena newspaper reported on Monday.
Baltijas holdings bought 60 percent of the company together with its liabilities of some 10 million lats, for 10,001 lats, the newspaper said
The current balance sheet allows the debts to be capitalised, Diena writes.
Baltijas holdings already has a controlling stake in the Riga Shipyard, an official list company of the Riga bourse and Kvadrats, a local rubber producer.
